title: 2026 Topps Chrome Formula 1
catalogEvidence: Official product pages announce October 15, 2026. Product-page parallel numbering and value-box contents are separate from pack odds; individual parallel eligibility is not inferred. dataAudit: All six original PDF columns imported by ruled-cell boundaries; every base number 1–200 verified.
